After the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]] began in [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> the '''Magnus''', or [[Magnus (title)|ruler]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[O'reen]] and its [[O'reenian|native species]], took a wait-and-see approach to [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]-spanning conflict. On the one hand, the Magnus saw the war as an opportunity to spread O'reen's influence beyond the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]]. On the other, the ruler was wary of drawing unwanted attention from the warring factions. Nevertheless, all records of O'reen were lost to the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], one side of the war, after the [[Battle of Coruscant (Yuuzhan Vong War)|Battle of Coruscant]].<ref name="UR">''[[The Unknown Regions]]''</ref>
